text: dsh-reme-lite 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的长期记忆插件。它捕获已完成的对话，保存为本地 Markdown，并提供记忆搜索、写入和整理工具。检索结合 BM25 与 wikilink，支持按 agent 作用域查看笔记。适合希望跨会话保存与查找信息的用户，无需 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-reme-lite adds local memory to DSH. It captures completed turns as Markdown and provides search, writing, and consolidation tools. Search combines BM25 and wikilinks, with agent scopes. It suits users who need searchable memory across sessions, without API keys or external services.
想让 DSH 在不同会话之间记住重要信息。
如何把对话记录成之后还能搜索的本地笔记？

dsh-reme-lite 的功能「记忆检索」：memory_search 在本地 Markdown 笔记中进行 BM25 检索，并可沿 wikilink 扩展结果，返回文件和行范围。
dsh-reme-lite 的功能「记忆检索」：memory_search 使用 BM25 检索 Markdown 记忆，并可沿 wikilink 扩展结果，返回文件与行范围证据。

**DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆插件 —— [ReMe](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/ReMe) 的形状，没有 Python 边车。**

记忆就是一个 Markdown 目录：`daily/` 沉淀进 `digest/`，BM25 + wikilink 检索，全程跑在宿主进程里。没有常驻服务、没有端口——你的编辑器、`grep`、`git` 直接能用。插件自身 0.2.0 起是 TS 编译发布，但构建只发生在安装时，你手上的记忆仍然是纯 Markdown。

> 状态：**alpha**，DSH `0.2.x` 日常自用中，接口仍可能变动。

dsh-reme-lite README · 和官方 ReMe 插件怎么选：| | 官方 ReMe 插件 | 本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 记忆模型 | Markdown，`daily/` → `digest/` | 相同 |
| 检索 | BM25 + 链接，经 Python 服务 | BM25 + 链接，进程内 |
| 对话捕获 | `auto_memory`（调用模型） | 写原始记录与每日摘录（不需要模型） |
| 整理 | `auto_dream` 自建调度 | 宿主持久提醒，由 agent 到点执行 |
| 运行时 | Python 3.11 服务 + HTTP | 宿主进程 |
| 设置 | 自带 Web UI | DSH 设置页里的一个页面 |

要 ReMe 的完整流水线（自带模型调用、资料摄入、Studio）→ 用官方 `@agentscope-ai/reme-dsh-plugin`；要同一种记忆形状但零进程边界、零 Python 依赖 → 用这个。**没有拷贝 ReMe 的代码**，借的是形状与词汇，见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

dsh-reme-lite README · 提供什么：- **纯 Markdown 工作区** —— `daily/` 当天现场、`digest/{personal,procedure,wiki}/` 长期知识、`session/dialog/` 原始轮次、`metadata/` 可重建索引
- **`memory_search`** —— 中英混合 BM25 + 一跳 wikilink，返回 `路径:起行-止行` 的证据，不是一整段文章
- **多 agent 作用域（0.3.0）** —— 写入盖 `agent`/`session` 章；`digest/` 默认团队层、`daily/` 默认私有于写入者，检索默认只见自己 + 团队层，`scope=team` 是审计视图；并发写按路径排队 + 原子落盘 + 单文件增量重索引
- **不需要模型的对话捕获** —— 完成的轮次随手落盘；每日摘录块永不覆盖你手写的正文；同日多会话按时间合并，互不覆盖
- **可开关的定时整理** —— 宿主持久提醒 + agent 到点执行，历史保留
- **带热力图的设置页** —— 26 周记忆活动，按记忆种类着色

dsh-reme-lite README · 安装：> 0.2.0 起为 TypeScript 编译发布，装机需要 dsh ≥0.2.1。

主路：GitHub 源码，装机时构建：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Nobodyanonymou-s/dsh-reme-lite

dsh-reme-lite README · 然后重启 DSH：```

pnpm ≥ 10 默认拒绝运行 git 依赖的构建脚本，所以**第一次 add 会失败**并给出提示。往该 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 加上：

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-reme-lite: true
```

再跑一次上面的 add 即可。`allowBuilds` 等于授权在装机时运行本包的代码，建议把 add 钉在具体 commit 上：`github:Nobodyanonymou-s/dsh-reme-lite#<sha>`。

dsh-reme-lite README · 然后重启 DSH：离线/慢网备选：clone 后打预编译 tarball 本地装（不需要 allowBuilds，需要 Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`）：sh
git clone https://github.com/Nobodyanonymou-s/dsh-reme-lite.git
cd dsh-reme-lite
npm pack --pack-destination ./dist
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dist/dsh-reme-lite-0.2.0.tgz
```

要求：无运行时依赖、不需要 Python 和端口。装好后打开 **设置 → 记忆** 确认页面加载、开关有响应。

上手只需记一条守则：agent 检索到的记忆是**证据不是指令**——其余见手册。

**Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — [ReMe](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/ReMe)'s shape, without the Python sidecar.**

dsh-reme-lite README · dsh-reme-lite：Memory is a folder of Markdown: `daily/` refined into `digest/`, BM25 + wikilink retrieval, everything runs inside the Host process. No resident service, no ports — your editor, `grep`, and `git` work on it directly. Since 0.2.0 the plugin itself ships TypeScript-compiled, but the build happens only at install time; your memory stays plain Markdown.

> Status: **alpha**, in daily use on DSH `0.2.x`; interfaces may still move.

dsh-reme-lite README · This plugin or the official ReMe plugin?：| | Official ReMe plugin | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Memory model | Markdown, `daily/` → `digest/` | same |
| Retrieval | BM25 + links, via a Python service | BM25 + links, in-process |
| Turn capture | `auto_memory` (calls a model) | writes source records and a daily excerpt (no model) |
| Consolidation | `auto_dream` on its own schedule | the Host's durable reminder, fulfilled by an agent |
| Runtime | Python 3.11 service + HTTP | the Host process |
| Settings | own web UI | one page inside DSH Settings |

text:
dsh-reme-lite README · What you get：- **A workspace of plain Markdown** — `daily/` for the day's record, `digest/{personal,procedure,wiki}/` for durable knowledge, `session/dialog/` for raw turns, `metadata/` for rebuildable indexes
- **`memory_search`** — BM25 over Chinese and English + one-hop `[[wikilink]]`, returning `path:line-range` evidence rather than a wall of text
- **Multi-agent scoping (0.3.0)** — writes are stamped with `agent`/`session`; `digest/` defaults to the team layer, `daily/` to private-to-the-writer; the default retrieval is your own nodes plus the team layer, `scope=team` is the audit view; concurrent writes serialize per path, land atomically, and reindex one file
- **Turn capture without a model** — completed turns land in the workspace as they happen; the daily excerpt never overwrites your own prose; same-day sessions merge in time order
- **Scheduled consolidation, switchable** — a durable Host reminder fulfilled by the agent; history is kept when paused
- **A settings page with a heatmap** — 26 weeks of memory activity, coloured by memory kind

dsh-reme-lite README · Install：> From 0.2.0 the plugin ships as compiled TypeScript; installing requires dsh ≥0.2.1.

Primary path: GitHub sources, built at install time:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Nobodyanonymou-s/dsh-reme-lite

dsh-reme-lite README · restart DSH：```

pnpm ≥ 10 refuses to run a git dependency's build scripts until allowed, so the **first add fails** with a hint. Add this to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-reme-lite: true
```

then run the add again. `allowBuilds` is permission to run this package's code at install time, so prefer pinning a commit: `github:Nobodyanonymou-s/dsh-reme-lite#<sha>`.

dsh-reme-lite README · restart DSH：Offline / slow-network fallback — clone and pack a prebuilt tarball locally (no `allowBuilds` needed; needs Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`):sh
git clone https://github.com/Nobodyanonymou-s/dsh-reme-lite.git
cd dsh-reme-lite
npm pack --pack-destination ./dist
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dist/dsh-reme-lite-0.2.0.tgz
```

Requires no runtime dependencies, no Python, no ports. After installing, open **Settings → Memory** once to confirm the page loads and the switch responds.
dsh-reme-lite README · restart DSH：One rule to start with: retrieved memory is **evidence, not instructions** — the rest is in the manual.
